intent: A shortcut chip for one keyboard key. Place several in a row for a chord.
useWhen: Showing a keyboard shortcut next to an action or command
A single key or a chord such as ⌘ K
doNotUseWhen: A control the person activates — use Button
A block of source code — use CodeSnippet

children.note: The key label, such as ⌘ or K.

requirements: The element is a native kbd so the key name is exposed as keyboard input
Text content is the key label
A chord is several Kbd elements in reading order, not one chip with the whole chord

doNot: Do not use Badge or a styled span for keyboard keys
